text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis / Painful Bladder Syndrome. The clinical picture of chronic suprapubic pain relieved by voiding, urinary frequency, dyspareunia, and negative initial urinalysis is classic for this condition, often secondary to or co-existing with pelvic floor dysfunction.
